decisions.reason: The date changes do not alter the site-labeling requirement; the same message's separate 154Q-to-201 identifier decision is already represented.
The service-period date changes do not alter allocated-budget values, and the same message's FCC/FH and 154Q budget updates are already represented by a complete MODIFY.
The revised service dates and week count do not change whether or where the subcontractor signature is required.
The new service periods may be inputs for support-sheet calculations, but no session counts or rates are supplied, and it is unclear which site's Annex B receives the four-week correction.
